input.question: What is the profession of S. John Ross?

documents.text: Award for a short stint as editor of "Pyramid" magazine, and was named to the Order of the Pineapple along with author Adam Gorightly in 2013. "Risus 1.5" was named Best Free RPG at RPGnet in 2001 and he contributed to "Pulp Hero" which received a Silver ENnie for Best Writing in 2006. Ross has been a named guest at several conventions including Technicon in 1995, 1997, and 1998; A-Kon in 2004 and 2009; and Starland Gamefest in 2013. Ross was a special guest at GameFest held in May 2014. S. John Ross was born as Samuel John Ross Jr.,
